fact: Car 16 collided with Car 44 at Turn 7.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 16 attempted to overtake Car 44 on the inside at Turn 7. The Stewards noted that Car 16 initiated the overtaking manoeuvre from a considerable distance behind Car 44, attempting to position his car on the inside. In assessing the incident, the Stewards also took into account the FIA Driving Standards Guidelines, in particular the criteria applicable to overtaking manoeuvres on the inside of a corner. The Stewards determined that the front axle of Car 16 was not at least alongside the mirror of Car 44 at the apex of the corner. The Stewards therefore determined that Car 16 had not earned the right to the corner at Turn 7 and was wholly to blame for the resulting collision. Accordingly, the Stewards imposed a 10-second time penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 16 Causing A Collision With Car 44
